newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Polar Mines hikes capital to 13 bln pesos.
newsitem.headline: Polar Mines hikes capital to 13 bln pesos.

text.p: The board of Polar Mines and Development Corp has approved an increase in the company's authorised capital stock to 13 billion pesos from 100 million pesos.
In a disclosure to the Securities and Exchange Commission on Friday, the mining firm said its board also approved an increase in the par value of Polar shares from one centavo to one peso per share.
Polar said that a special stockholders meeting was set on March 31 to seek approval for the increase in capital and par value of Polar shares.
